0003053000030015.zh_desc: 4 号执行头 Pogopin 接触异常。请用无尘布将执行头及执行头转换器上的 Pogopin 擦拭干净后，点击继续按钮尝试恢复任务。若仍报错，请联系技术支持。

0003053000030016.en_desc: Toolhead 4 placement anomaly. Manually reinstall the toolhead into its dock, then tap to attempt resuming the job. If the error persists, contact Technical Support.
0003053000030016.zh_desc: 4 号执行头放置状态异常。请手动将该执行头装回放置架后，点击继续按钮尝试恢复任务。若仍报错，请联系技术支持。

0003053000030017.en_desc: The PEI sheet is not properly positioned. Correctly place the PEI sheet and retry.
0003053000030017.zh_desc: PEI 钢板放置状态不正确。请将 PEI 钢板放置好，然后重试。

0003053100000010.en_desc: The print file contains G-code commands that are not supported by this device. Printing has been terminated.
0003053100000010.zh_desc: 打印文件中包含设备暂不支持的 G-code 指令，打印已终止。
0003053100000010.zh_title: 无法识别 G-code 指令

0003053100000014.en_desc: The nozzle diameter in the print file does not match the nozzle diameter of the target toolhead. Verify the slicer settings or replace the nozzle with a matching one, then try again.
0003053100000014.zh_desc: 打印文件中的喷嘴直径与目标打印头的喷嘴直径不一致。请确认切片设置或更换匹配的喷嘴，然后重试。

0003053100000018.en_desc: Filament does not meet the calibration requirements for the nozzle diameter corresponding to nozzle.
0003053100000018.zh_desc: 耗材不符合当前喷嘴直径对应的校准要求。
